title: I built a cozy sheep farming game 🐑
author: DerAwesumdude
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I've been working on a small cozy browser game called **NOT MY SHEEP!** and the trailer is attached.

![video](c2woebvu5nxh1 "NOT MY SHEEP! (Gameplay Trailer)")

You build pens, take care of a growing flock, milk and shear the sheep, sell what you get and keep the wolf away at night. There are four seasons, a dog, and a photo mode for your farm. I wanted it to feel calm, so sheep never starve and the wolf always gives you a warning first.

Since this is the vibe coding sub, here is how it was made: I built the whole thing with Claude Code. Every sprite is a text pixel map in the code, all sounds are synthesized with Web Audio, and there are no external assets. The game simulation is fully separated from rendering, which made it easy to cover with tests (over 470 by now). The trailer is also not a screen recording. It is rendered frame by frame from the real game in a headless browser.

I'm looking for testers. You can join the waitlist on the site, and if you'd like to try it earlier, just comment or send me a DM and I'll give you early access. I'd like to know what is confusing, what gets boring, and where it breaks on your device. Harsh feedback is fine, that's what I'm here for.

Link: [https://www.notmysheep.de/en/?utm\_source=reddit](https://www.notmysheep.de/en/?utm_source=reddit)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow, including what worked and what didn't.
